name: Add a distributable installer package built by npm run package
request: Add a distributable installer package built by npm run package
checks: npm run package passed end to end: typecheck, build, 437 tests / 0 failed, validate, then a 338 KB archive of 38 files that the packager verified against dist/
Windows Expand-Archive unpacked the archive and all 38 extracted files hash-match dist/ byte-for-byte
Get-FileHash confirmed the .sha256 sidecar matches the archive
git diff --stat over every extension source path returned empty
result:
Added an installer: 
pm run package runs the full check then writes releases/profile-vault-react-<version>.zip (INSTALL.md + a byte-for-byte copy of dist/ under extension/) and a .sha256 sidecar. New scripts/zip.mjs writes and reads the ZIP format by hand so no build dependency is added; scripts/package.mjs reads only dist/, refuses a missing or inconsistent build by name, and reads its own archive back — inflating every entry, checking every CRC and comparing against dist/ — before writing it. Added INSTALL.md (Load unpacked steps, why Chrome refuses a .crx or .exe, the keep-the-folder and same-path warnings, data does not travel plus Export all CSV / Import CSV, updating, verifying, uninstalling, troubleshooting), tests/packaging.test.js (5 tests), gitignored releases/, and documented it in CLAUDE.md, README.md and CHANGELOG.md. No extension file changed: manifest.json, content.js, connections.js, applicants.js, src/, the four pages, CSS, icons and vendor all have a zero-line diff.
